lines.zh: 我绕着擂台走，检查边绳。
lines.en: I walk the ring, checking the ropes.

lines.zh: 我从台边走到台心，再走回来。
lines.en: I pace from the edge to the center and back.

lines.zh: 脚步稳一点，麦克风别晃。
lines.en: Steady steps; don't wobble the microphone.
I make a slow pass along the stands.
I straighten the mic and walk on.

lines.zh: 这块地板，我踩了十几年。
lines.en: I've trodden this floor for over a decade.

lines.zh: 我走过去，和裁判点了个头。
lines.en: I walk over and nod to the referee.

lines.zh: 开幕式之前，我得走一圈。
lines.en: Before the opening, I must make a round.
I count the steps as I climb.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，让大家都看见。
lines.en: I walk slowly so everyone sees me.
I go around the chair in the corner.

lines.zh: 每一步都要走出气派来。
lines.en: Every step must have presence.
I drift toward the announcer's stand.
Once this round is done, we begin.

lines.zh: 我站在台边，等宣布开场。
lines.en: I wait at ringside to announce the start.

lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，试了试音。
lines.en: I clear my throat and test the sound.
The stands aren't full yet.

lines.zh: 我看了看手里的对阵表。
lines.en: I glance at the bracket in my hand.

lines.zh: 灯光很亮，照得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The lights are bright enough to blind me.
I straighten my tie.
My shirt is still pressed flat.
The crowd is too loud; I'll wait.
I rehearse the opening lines silently.
The gong hasn't sounded; I stand ready.

lines.zh: 我把话筒换到另一只手。
lines.en: I shift the mic to my other hand.

lines.zh: 这地方，安静下来才好开口。
lines.en: Only when it quiets can I speak.
I sweep my eyes over the stands.
The flags by the ring are still up.
You, contestant, step forward.
Let me see your entry form.
What's your name? Louder.
With that build, you could fight.

lines.zh: 选手上台前，先过我这关。
lines.en: Fighters pass my desk before the stage.
Before you step up, don't say much.

lines.zh: 你要是赢了，我替你报名字。
lines.en: If you win, I'll call your name.
I'll remember that look in your eyes.
The crowd is watching; stand firm.
I raise the mic, then lower it.
You're new, aren't you? Keep your hands steady.
I smile; it's a professional smile.
There's one rule: don't die.
I ask you: are you ready?
Your opponent is already waiting.
This stage is yours, and his.
Hey, I'm the announcer!
This isn't in the rules.
I clutch my shoulder and back off.
Not the face; I go on camera.
I straighten my crooked tie.
The whole crowd saw that.
I take a breath and stand straight.

lines.zh: 你这一拳，我记在册子上。
lines.en: I'll note that punch in the record.
I must keep my dignity.
Even an announcer's throat can hurt.
This is for me? How kind.

lines.zh: 我收下，回头替你多说两句。
lines.en: I'll take it and talk you up later.
On duty, I don't drink much.
I'll remember this gesture.
Leave it for now; after the match.
So thoughtful it puts me on the spot.
I tuck it into my inner pocket.
The crowd can't see this, right?
I take the gift; fame is separate.
Don't be so formal next time.
Careful, don't knock the mic away.
I step toward the edge to make room.

lines.zh: 这里是选手通道，让一让。
lines.en: This is the fighter's passage; make way.

lines.zh: 撞到我没关系，撞到话筒不行。
lines.en: Bumping me is fine; the mic isn't.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来挡了一下。
lines.en: I raise my hand to fend it off.
Don't crowd the stage; the crowd is below.
Steady there; let me help you.
This platform can't take rough handling.
I step back half a pace, politely.
Everyone step back; we'll all be fine.

lines.zh: 她也是会场的老工作人员。
lines.en: She's long worked this arena too.

lines.zh: 比赛结束后，我们一起收场。
lines.en: After the match, we clean up together.

lines.zh: 我替她拿了一半的道具。
lines.en: I carry half her props.
Backstage lights are dimmer than the ring.
She says I shout too loudly.
I apologize, smiling, and don't change.

lines.zh: 我们一起数着今天的观众。
lines.en: We count today's audience together.
In this trade, a companion is good.

lines.zh: 台上的事，下了台就别提。
lines.en: What happens on stage stays off stage.
Another match tomorrow; sleep early.
I bend and pick up the dropped mic.
Whose ticket stub is this?

lines.zh: 我把椅子扶正，摆在边上。
lines.en: I right the chair and set it aside.
I gather the paper off the floor.
This belongs backstage.
Thirty years holding this microphone.
I'll take it to lost and found.
Nothing loose is allowed on the stage.

lines.zh: 我把它揣进衣袋，先收着。
lines.en: I slip it in my pocket for now.
Even this little thing is my job.
I don't fight here.
If you want to fight, get on the stage.
I raise a hand to ask the crowd back.
This match isn't regulation.
I look to the referee for a signal.
Don't make a scene here; it's ugly.
I lift the mic to my mouth.
This calls for the guards.
Both sides, hold for a moment.

lines.zh: 我退到台边，把场地让开。
lines.en: I retreat to the edge and clear the floor.
I watch you and say nothing more.
I lower the microphone.
The crowd is watching; don't be reckless.
I step aside; the camera's yours.
The referee is already heading over.

lines.zh: 我抬手示意后面的人退。
lines.en: I wave the people behind back.
I stay still, only watching you.
One step more and you cross the line.
I rest my hand on the platform edge.
My finger points to the center of the ring.
I only gave you a shove.

lines.zh: 我用手肘挡开你的拳头。
lines.en: I block your fist with my forearm.
That isn't a foul, is it?
I back against the ropes.
I raise the mic to block.
Stop; the stage is going to collapse.
I raise my hand and announce the start.
These fists were never trained.

lines.zh: 这一推，只是想分开你们。
lines.en: This shove is only to separate you.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一下，扶住绳子。
lines.en: I stumble and grab the ropes.

lines.zh: 我站上发令台，话筒已开。
lines.en: I take the announcer's stand, mic live.

lines.zh: 各位观众，比赛即将开始。
lines.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the match begins soon.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，示意安静。
lines.en: I raise my hand for silence.
The lights hit and I stand tall.
The World Tournament is open.
I walk from backstage to the front.
I'll be calling this match.
The crowd quiets and I begin.
I open the roster to the first page.
Those who fight, come up.

lines.zh: 火苗窜到我的袖口，我赶紧拍。
lines.en: Flames reach my cuff; I slap them out.

lines.zh: 我从台边摔下去，摔得结实。
lines.en: I fall off the platform and land hard.

lines.zh: 水没到胸口，话筒都湿了。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and soaks the mic.

lines.zh: 爆响过后，我耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: After the blast, my ears ring.
An arrow grazes my hat.

lines.zh: 一股怪力把我推得转了半圈。
lines.en: Strange force spins me half around.

lines.zh: 我一整天没吃饭，喊不动了。
lines.en: I haven't eaten all day; I can't shout.
The thunder is louder than my voice.

lines.zh: 台下突然空了，我踩不到地。
lines.en: The floor vanishes and I have no footing.
